content.Overview: This section discusses clinical guidelines and studies pertaining to thoracic and abdominal aortic aneurysms. It covers topics such as the treatment of aortic arch aneurysms, outcomes of hybrid procedures, and recommendations for frozen elephant trunk techniques.
